messages:
maria: FYI I found a partner API key embedded in a CI artifact uploaded to our internal artifact bucket. not public externally but likely accessible to a subset of engineers. starting containment here.

devsec: thanks. which artifact and where in the repo? can you paste a redacted line?

maria: artifact: ci-builds/ingest/2024-11-02/artifact.tgz path=./build/logs/debug.log line: "partner_key=REDACTED_TOKEN_ABC123 service=ingest-collector env=prod"

raj: oof. that looks like a long-lived partner key (partner 0x77). immediate steps: 1) rotate partner key with partner 2) block key usage via KMS denylist/rule 3) check for any outgoing calls using that key in last 48h.

sec-oncall: initiating search: scanning egress logs and api-gateway for X-Partner-Key= headers. will report matches in 10m.

jin: RBAC note: CI runner had write access to artifact bucket and also a clusterrolebinding to read secrets from namespace prod-ops (leftover cf). recommend we remove secret-read permission from CI runner now.

maria: removing binding now: kubectl delete clusterrolebinding ci-runner-secret-reader --dry-run=client && kubectl apply -f - (will confirm).

ops-bot: ops-bot: clusterrolebinding 'ci-runner-secret-reader' deleted by maria @ 1745210050 :white_check_mark:

sec-oncall: egress scan found 3 calls to partner API from svc=collector-worker between 1745208000 and 1745209000. caller used svcacct=collector-sa. marking as used.

raj: plan of record: A) request partner revoke/issue new key; B) rotate our svcacct creds; C) if key was stored in Vault as transit-wrapped ciphertext, rewrap to new key alias; D) run audit to enumerate all Vault paths referencing that partner id. owners: partner=maria, svcacct rotation=jin, rewrap=devsec, audit=sec-oncall.

devsec: quick question about KMS: partner keys were stored as Vault transit ciphertext under transit/key-partner-0x77. are we okay to rewrap server-side or do we need partner involvement?

raj: we can rewrap ciphertext locally to a new KMS key version/alias and update vault: we should still ask partner to rotate their bearer token ASAP. rewrap avoids service downtime for services that fetch ciphertext from Vault.

maria: partner contacted and asked to revoke old key. they will produce new key and rotate their side in ~45m. sharing contact thread id: PART-342.

jin: rotating svcacct now. snippet: 
```
# rotate collector-sa secret
kubectl -n prod delete secret collector-sa-creds || true
vault kv put secret/prod/collector-sa token=$(generate_short_lived) ttl=1h
kubectl create secret generic collector-sa-creds --from-literal=token=$(vault read -field=token secret/prod/collector-sa)
kubectl rollout restart deployment/collector-worker
```

sec-oncall: please keep canary traffic small. I'll add alert: partner-key-usage-high if any 401/403 drops spike.

alert-bot: alert-bot: rule 'partner-key-usage-high' created by sec-oncall in #eng-security @ 1745211200 :rotating_light:

devsec: started rewrap: calling kms.rewrap(from_key=projects/..../oldAlias, to_key=newAlias) then vault write transits/update. logging request id rewrap-5542.

sec-oncall: audit report: no external data exfil detected, but 2 internal team members downloaded the artifact between 1745207000-1745207600. will reach out to them for interview.

maria: marking incident SEC-2025-121 as in-progress and will set containment=true after partner confirms revoke. ETA post-rotation validation 1745214500.

raj: post-incident actions: 1) disable cross-namespace secret reads by default for CI runners 2) add pre-merge CI check to scrub logs/artifacts for token-looking strings 3) rotate long-lived partner keys to short-lived ephemeral tokens via our onboarding proxy.

maria: containment confirmed. partner rotated key at 1745214300 and uploaded to onboarding endpoint. starting canary rollout.

jin: canary 10% shows no auth errors. promoting to 50% and will monitor for 20m.

sec-oncall: closing note: please attach the artifact scan rule PR to the postmortem doc. scheduling postmortem tomorrow 10:00am.

maria: thanks all, filing follow-ups to backlog and adding remediation tickets. :thumbsup:
